patterns.note: Project showcase uses a dynamic two-column grid where image-heavy cards are presented with minimal text overlays.
Prominent, wide, and bold sans-serif typography is used for brand identity and key headings, creating a strong graphic presence.
A high-contrast palette features a clean white background punctuated by vibrant, saturated accent colors used for underlines, frames, and subtle background elements.
The initial hero section features a large graphic element that slides vertically out of view as the user scrolls, revealing the content below.
Each project entry functions as a distinct card, featuring a large image and concise descriptive text with category tags.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations to create a dynamic reveal effect for the hero section, where a large graphic element slides upwards to expose the main content. Subsequent content sections also appear to animate into view as they enter the viewport.
A responsive grid system is used to display project cards, allowing for varied image aspect ratios while maintaining a consistent visual flow.

A limited set of highly saturated accent colors are strategically applied to text underlines, graphic frames, and small background elements to draw attention and reinforce brand identity against a predominantly neutral background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful display headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within project cards; the initial hero is very airy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a bold, graphic, almost brutalist-inspired typography for its main branding, combined with a vibrant, high-contrast accent color palette, sets it apart. The initial hero reveal, where a large graphic slides away, creates a memorable and engaging entry point.
